modelFields.coverageLabel: Complete 120-credit requirement ledger with named online major selections and separately sourced transfer options.
rulesNotes: Baseline keeps UNIV 104 at three credits and retains both conditional religion-waiver requirements.
The published course sequence uses HIUS 221 and GEOG 200 in information literacy. Each is allocated once to its foundational requirement and also fulfils the corresponding general-education position.

The eight major elective selections are distinct, three-credit upper-level courses explicitly offered online. These are proposed choices within the published department/level restrictions, not mandatory choices for every History student.
Thirty upper-level credits are carried by the major: HIST 300, HIST 491 and eight named upper-level history electives.
The complete 42-credit Major Requirements ledger is the retained major-residency basis; this does not create a separate minimum for every history subject.
Upper-level GEOG courses in free electives are strongly recommended, not required. This baseline does not turn that recommendation into a mandatory block.
This History degree is not represented as a teacher-licensure program.

obligations.title: UNIV 104 evaluation
obligations.notes: The baseline retains the three-credit case. An individual zero-credit evaluation can replace these credits with three more elective credits within the published range.

graduationRequirements.title: Graduation application
graduationRequirements.description: Submit the degree completion application during the final anticipated semester.

graduationRequirements.title: Major course grades
graduationRequirements.detail: At least C in upper-level courses in the major.

institutionMinCredits.calculation: 25% of this published degree total must be completed at Liberty.

externalMaxCredits.calculation: Published degree total less the 25% institutional minimum.
externalMaxCredits.scope: Overall outside-credit ceiling only. This does not establish a separate aggregate alternative-credit ceiling or a particular provider award.

majorInstitutionFraction.scope: 25% of the exact major/minor component, unless the degree completion plan specifies otherwise. The denominator remains degree-specific.

majorResidencyBasisCredits.calculation: 6 major-foundational plus 36 major-course credits under Major Requirements, with six shared general-education credits counted once.

unresolved: State-specific general-education additions and a student’s admission/catalog rights depend on the individual record. Published outside-course options remain separate from an individual transfer award.

gradePolicy.detail: At least C in upper-level courses in the major.

exclusions: The full-time rate requires at least 12 semester credits; eight-week subterms are not separate billing semesters.
Program-specific, military and other eligibility-based rates are outside this standard-rate model.
Technology, completion and course-specific fees remain separate.

publishedFees.label: Online technology fee
publishedFees.eligibility: Standard online fee; waived for actively serving military and their spouses under the published policy.

policyReview.message: The reviewed online undergraduate catalog publishes no separate aggregate alternative-credit ceiling. Its documented overall transfer and degree/major residency rules remain enforced. Each outside course still requires its own published receiving award and provider eligibility; no numeric alternative-credit allowance or student award is inferred.

onlineGuideAwardReview.scope: Exact receiving awards and proposed degree placements only; provider quantities and eligibility remain separate.
